organic_solution.title: Organic / Bio-control Advisory
organic_solution.treatment: Neem Oil Extract (3%) or Trichoderma harzianum bio-fungicide
organic_solution.instructions: Spray Neem oil solution at 5ml/L of water every 7 days during high humidity. Apply Trichoderma to root zone to suppress fungal spores.
organic_solution.benefits: Eco-friendly, safe for pollinators, zero chemical residue.

chemical_solution.title: Chemical Solution Advisory
chemical_solution.instructions: Apply at first sign of circular concentric spots on lower leaves. Ensure full canopy coverage during early morning.

organic_solution.title: Organic / Bio-control Advisory
organic_solution.instructions: Apply copper octanoate or Bacillus subtilis spray every 5-7 days. Prune affected stems immediately and burn infected foliage.
organic_solution.benefits: Approved for organic farming, prevents spore germination.

chemical_solution.title: Chemical Solution Advisory
chemical_solution.instructions: Apply systemically when wet, cool conditions persist (>90% RH, 15-22°C). Repeat at 10-day intervals if symptoms persist.
